quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is the very first tiny green shoot from a seed!
quests.question: Sprout
quests.hint: This is the very first sign that a seed has begun to grow.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Sprout is correct because it is the first tiny green shoot that grows from a seed.
quests.funFact: Some seeds can sprout in just a few days if the soil is warm and wet enough!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a thin, twisting plant that climbs up walls or trees!
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This long, bendy plant wraps itself around anything it can reach.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Vine is correct because it is a thin, twisting plant that climbs up as it grows.
quests.funFact: Some vines can grow many meters in just a single growing season!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a sharp, pointy part some plants grow for protection!
quests.question: Thorn
quests.hint: You need to be careful picking a rose because of this sharp little point.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Thorn is correct because it is a sharp, pointy part that protects some plants.
quests.funFact: Thorns help keep hungry animals from eating the plant that grows them!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a tree's flower blooming in the springtime!
quests.question: Blossom
quests.hint: Whole trees can turn pink or white when covered in these delicate spring flowers.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Blossom is correct because it is a tree's flower that blooms in the springtime.
quests.funFact: Cherry blossom trees can be covered in thousands of tiny pink flowers all at once!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is the very top, pointed part of a mountain!
quests.question: Peak
quests.hint: Climbers work for days just to reach the very top of this pointed spot.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Peak is correct because it is the very top, pointed part of a mountain.
quests.funFact: The highest peak in the world is at the very top of Mount Everest!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a long, narrow strip of high land along the top of hills!
quests.question: Ridge
quests.hint: This long, raised strip connects one hilltop to another like a rocky spine.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Ridge is correct because it is a long, narrow strip of high land along a row of hills.
quests.funFact: Hikers often walk right along a ridge to enjoy a view on both sides at once!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that is a field full of grass and wildflowers!
quests.question: Meadow
quests.hint: Butterflies love to flutter around the colorful flowers growing in this open field.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Meadow is correct because it is a field full of grass and colorful wildflowers.
quests.funFact: A meadow left alone can fill up with dozens of different kinds of wildflowers!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a tall hill of sand shaped by the wind!
quests.question: Dune
quests.hint: The wind slowly piles up sand into this tall, curving shape over time.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Dune is correct because it is a tall hill of sand shaped by the wind.
quests.funFact: Some sand dunes are tall enough to be climbed like a small mountain!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a part of the sea that curves into the land!
quests.question: Bay
quests.hint: This calm, curved area is more sheltered from waves than the open sea.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Bay is correct because it is a part of the sea that curves into the land.
quests.funFact: Many big cities were built next to a bay because ships can dock there safely!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a small, sheltered inlet tucked into a rocky coastline!
quests.question: Cove
quests.hint: This tiny, hidden patch of water and sand is smaller and cozier than a bay.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Cove is correct because it is a small, sheltered inlet tucked into a rocky coastline.
quests.funFact: Pirates in old stories were often said to hide their ships in a quiet, hidden cove!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that pushes up through the soil right after a seed wakes up!
quests.question: Sprout
quests.hint: This tiny green shoot has not grown any leaves just yet.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Sprout is correct because it pushes up through the soil as a seed first wakes up.
quests.funFact: A sprout always grows upward, reaching for sunlight, no matter which way its seed was planted!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that winds its way up a trellis or fence as it grows!
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This long, green plant does not stand up straight on its own.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Vine is correct because it winds and climbs upward instead of standing straight on its own.
quests.funFact: Grapes grow on a kind of vine that people have grown for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that can prick your finger if you touch a rose stem!
quests.question: Thorn
quests.hint: This tiny, sharp spike grows right along a plant's stem or branch.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Thorn is correct because it is the sharp spike that can prick your finger on a rose stem.
quests.funFact: Not every prickly plant has true thorns — some have soft prickles instead!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that covers a fruit tree's branches before the fruit even appears!
quests.question: Blossom
quests.hint: These delicate flowers must open before any fruit can start to grow.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Blossom is correct because it covers a tree's branches with flowers before fruit appears.
quests.funFact: Apple trees are completely covered in white and pink blossoms every spring!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that pokes up above the clouds on a very tall mountain!
quests.question: Peak
quests.hint: Snow often stays on this spot all year, even in the middle of summer.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Peak is correct because it is the tall, pointed top that can poke up above the clouds.
quests.funFact: Some mountain peaks are so tall that there is barely any air left to breathe!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that looks like a long, bumpy spine running across the land!
quests.question: Ridge
quests.hint: This raised strip of land often connects one mountain to the next.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Ridge is correct because it looks like a long, bumpy spine of raised land.
quests.funFact: Some mountain ridges stretch for hundreds of miles across a whole country!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place where soft grass and flowers grow freely without any farming!
quests.question: Meadow
quests.hint: This peaceful, open field is perfect for a relaxing picnic in the sun.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Meadow is correct because its grass and flowers grow freely without being farmed.
quests.funFact: Many small animals and insects depend on a meadow's flowers for food!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that slowly moves and changes shape as the wind blows sand!
quests.question: Dune
quests.hint: This sandy hill never looks exactly the same from one week to the next.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Dune is correct because the wind slowly moves and reshapes its sand over time.
quests.funFact: Some desert dunes can slowly travel many meters every single year!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object where ships can shelter safely from big ocean waves!
quests.question: Bay
quests.hint: The land curves around this calm patch of water, protecting it from rough seas.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Bay is correct because its curved shape shelters ships from big ocean waves.
quests.funFact: Some of the world's biggest harbors are found inside a wide, calm bay!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a tiny, calm beach hidden between two rocky cliffs!
quests.question: Cove
quests.hint: You might have to walk down a narrow path to reach this small, secret spot.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Cove is correct because it is a tiny, calm beach hidden between rocky cliffs.
quests.funFact: Some coves can only be reached by boat because the cliffs around them are so steep!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is small, green, and just barely peeking out of the ground!
quests.question: Sprout
quests.hint: In just a few weeks, this tiny shoot could grow into a full plant.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Sprout is correct because it is the small green shoot just peeking out of the ground.
quests.funFact: Bean sprouts can grow noticeably taller in just a single day!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object with long, trailing stems that wrap around anything nearby!
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This plant needs something else to lean on or climb up.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Vine is correct because its long stems trail and wrap around nearby things for support.
quests.funFact: Some jungle vines grow so thick that animals can swing from them!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that keeps hungry animals away from a prickly bush!
quests.question: Thorn
quests.hint: This small, sharp point makes a plant harder and less tasty to nibble on.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Thorn is correct because its sharp point keeps hungry animals from nibbling on the plant.
quests.funFact: Some desert plants grow thorns instead of leaves to help save water!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that falls like colorful confetti from a flowering tree in spring!
quests.question: Blossom
quests.hint: A gentle breeze can shake thousands of these delicate petals loose from the branches.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Blossom is correct because it falls like confetti from a flowering tree in the spring.
quests.funFact: Some countries celebrate special festivals just to admire trees full of blossoms!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that a mountain climber dreams of finally standing on top of!
quests.question: Peak
quests.hint: Reaching this exact spot is the whole goal of climbing a mountain.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Peak is correct because it is the very top spot that climbers dream of reaching.
quests.funFact: Many mountain peaks are named after the very first person who ever climbed them!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object where the land rises up in a long, narrow line!
quests.question: Ridge
quests.hint: Walking along the very top of this gives you a view of both sides below.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Ridge is correct because the land rises up in one long, narrow line.
quests.funFact: Ridges often form where two huge pieces of the Earth's crust have pushed together!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that turns colorful with blooming flowers every spring!
quests.question: Meadow
quests.hint: This grassy, open space bursts with new colors as the weather warms up.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Meadow is correct because it turns colorful with blooming wildflowers every spring.
quests.funFact: Some meadows are specially protected because so many rare flowers grow there!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object with rippled patterns carved into its sandy slopes by the wind!
quests.question: Dune
quests.hint: You can see wavy little ripple lines all along the side of this sandy hill.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Dune is correct because the wind carves rippled patterns into its sandy slopes.
quests.funFact: Sliding down a giant sand dune is a popular adventure in many desert countries!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is calmer than the open ocean because land wraps around it!
quests.question: Bay
quests.hint: Fishing boats often prefer this calmer, curved stretch of coastal water.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Bay is correct because the land wrapping around it keeps its water calmer than the open ocean.
quests.funFact: The Bay of Bengal is one of the largest bays found anywhere in the world!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that feels like a secret little beach all of your own!
quests.question: Cove
quests.hint: This small, curved inlet is often much quieter than a big, busy beach.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Cove is correct because its small, curved shape feels like a secret, quiet beach.
quests.funFact: Smugglers in old times often used hidden coves to secretly land their boats at night!
